_README: Where the vendored CRD schemas in this directory come from. They are byte-identical copies of the controller-gen output in nanohype/eks-agent-platform at `upstream.ref` — never hand-edit them. `sha256` is verified by crd_contract_test.go and by the validator itself before any schema is parsed, so a copy edited to admit a manifest the operator would reject aborts the run instead of being trusted. `task crd:check` re-verifies the digests and matches the bytes against upstream at that same ref; `task crd:sync -- <sha>` moves the pin and rewrites the digests together. See README.md here.
